text: Security is a crucial part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to encrypt data between the user and the server, protecting sensitive information like passwords. Strong authentication, such as multi-factor login, helps ensure that only the right people access accounts. Developers must also validate all user input to prevent attacks like SQL injection and cross-site scripting. Common vulnerabilities, including broken access control and insecure storage, are often listed by security organisations, so teams should review these risks regularly. By following secure coding practices and testing their applications, developers can build safer websites and protect their users from cyber threats.
